Implement an asynchronous FIFO with 2**ASIZE entries of DSIZE bits.

wclk and rclk are independent clocks. Please take care of any clock-domain crossings between them. The resets are active-low.

Store words written on one side and return them in order on the other. Honor full, empty, and almost flags without losing or repeating data. Pointers cross as acknowledged binary snapshots, so full and empty can lag. rdata is one read-clock sample, and rempty may remain high for multiple read clocks between stored words.
